reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promotion_products pp WHERE pp.product_id = p.product_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM competitor_prices cp WHERE cp.product_id = p.product_id AND cp.competitor = 'Bliksem')
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM promotion_products)
  AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Bliksem')

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cp.competitor = 'Bliksem'

other_way.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cp.competitor = 'Bliksem'
other_way.tradeoff: Joining both tables with DISTINCT gives the same products, but builds every promotion and check pair first.
